correction.defect: SSC 0.1 described signatures/field lists using finite indexing language that would presuppose the index semantics DNWF is intended to support.
correction.repair: Represent each candidate signature as a finite extensional metadata graph present in the packet. Constructor fields are ordered by explicit first/next/last incidences; no numeric index, cardinality, arithmetic or list theory is assumed.

items.body: A constructor signature Sigma is a finite extensional metadata graph explicitly present in the qualification packet. It declares constructor tags and, for each constructor, zero or more ordered field-role incidences using explicit first/next/last structure. Each field role is marked either recursive into the generated carrier or external into a separately declared raw carrier. No arithmetic or numeric indexing is assumed by the signature representation.
Given Sigma, the generated carrier Mu(Sigma) contains all and only finite well-founded constructor trees formed from the tags and field roles declared by Sigma; no other members are admitted.
Different constructor tags produce distinct members of Mu(Sigma). For one constructor tag, two constructed members are equal exactly when every corresponding ordered field value is equal.
For any property P on Mu(Sigma), if every constructor case preserves P assuming P for each recursive field, then P holds for every member of Mu(Sigma).

For any target carrier A and one target constructor-function for each Sigma constructor, there exists exactly one fold map fold:Mu(Sigma)->A whose value on a constructed member is the corresponding target constructor-function applied to the folded recursive fields and unchanged external fields.
No member of Mu(Sigma) has an infinite descending chain through recursive fields; every member is a finite constructor tree, and recursive definitions may recurse only through recursive fields.

DNWF supplies only generic well-founded constructor, structural-induction, and structural-fold authority. It supplies no arithmetic, ordering, cardinality, algebra, topology, geometry, physics, source-domain object, or source-specific theorem.

anti_scope: No Woit or Lisi source object appears in DNWF semantics.
No arithmetic operation, numeric index, or cardinality predicate is primitive DNWF authority.
DNWF may not be consumed by W, L, or DNIA until independently qualified.
required_qualification: Q0 source freeze and interpretation closure
Q3 two independent fresh cold reconstructions
